name: ECOWAS Visa-Free Entry
summary: ECOWAS citizens enter The Gambia without a visa with a valid travel document. Entry clearance is valid 30 days.

stay.note: Entry clearance valid for 30 days per the immigration page.

name: Gambia Entry Visa
summary: Other nationals may get a visa from a Gambian embassy or consulate, or on arrival at gazetted ports of entry. Visa fees and exempt nationalities were not listed on the page. A Securiport fee of D1000 (about US$20) applies on arrival and departure.

other: Visa fees and visa-free nationalities not confirmed from an official page.
Entry is never guaranteed. The officer at the port decides.

fees.label: Securiport fee, on arrival and departure

name: Residence Permit
summary: Living in The Gambia needs special immigration status, a valid pass or permit, or being a dependant of someone who has one. Requirements include an employment contract, health certificates and visible means of support. Categories and fees were not listed.

other: Permit categories, fees and processing not confirmed from an official page.
